summary: Hydro One Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that the Ontario government designated it to develop and construct a new Red Lake Transmission Line in northwestern Ontario. The project involves a double-circuit 230kV line expected to add about 400 megawatts and be in service by the early 2030s. First Nations can invest in a 50% equity stake in the transmission line component. The filing is a routine regulatory designation for a transmission infrastructure project and does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
